evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward through growth (2.90 → 3.18 Torr from t=2640 to 3240), far outside the ~0.02 Torr scatter seen in purge/ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from a flow change
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with normal heater power, so temperature control is nominal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An O2/leak-rate measurement or a pump-down/flow-step test: with O2 unavailable, briefly stepping Ar (or isolating the tube) would distinguish a seal leak (pressure rises independent of flow, air ingress) from a partial exhaust blockage (pressure scales with flow).
